query:
SELECT id, shareCode, LENGTH(reportData) as data_size, 
  SUBSTRING(CAST(reportData AS CHAR), 1, 500) as data_preview
FROM universal_shareable_reports 
WHERE reportType = 'validator' 
ORDER BY id DESC 
LIMIT 3;
